description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController, which provides several basic endpoints including a welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller providing basic endpoints for a web application, including welcome message, documentation redirect, health status, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a simple welcome message to indicate the application is running.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Builds and redirects to the Swagger UI page, preserving the original request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a string indicating the application's health status ('OK').

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns basic information about the application, including its name.
